sections.Profile:
The "Hurricane" pinball machine, released by Williams in August 1991, is the third and final installment in Barry Oursler's amusement park-themed trilogy, following "Comet" and "Cyclone." Designed by Barry Oursler with artwork by John Youssi and Python Anghelo, the game features vibrant carnival-themed visuals and a variety of engaging mechanical features.
